meta.title: Password Crack Time Estimator - S-Jiffy
meta.description: Estimate brute-force cracking time based on password length, character set, and attack speed, and assess password strength.
desc: Estimate brute-force cracking time based on password length, character set, and attack speed, and assess password strength.
ui.100: Please select at least one character set
ui.101: The combination space is too large to compute, please shorten the password
ui.102: Please enter a password to evaluate
adv.weakest: This password can be cracked instantly. Lengthen it to 12+ characters, enable multiple character sets, and avoid common words, birthdays, or sequential numbers.
adv.weak: This password is relatively weak. Lengthen it and add more character set types; ideally use a password manager to generate a random password.
adv.fair: This password is of average strength. Lengthen it to 12-16 characters, enable all character sets, and prefer a password manager.
adv.strong: This password is strong. Keep its randomness and length, and enable two-factor authentication for extra security.
adv.uncrackable: This password is virtually impossible to crack by brute force. Store it safely with a password manager and avoid reusing it across sites.
